author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The new season of Batman: The Caped Crusader kicks off on July 31, and anyone looking to join the world's greatest detective in solving some mysteries can also jump into a new game launching the same day. Amazon Luna and Warner Bros. have announced Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles, which will be available for Amazon Prime members through the Luna library of streaming games at no extra cost. Amazon also revealed today that Luna will be rolling out to Prime Video on Fire TVs in the US and UK, and the games can be streamed directly from these devices. You can use a controller or a smartphone, making it easier to access games from a single app.

Set in the continuity of Caped Crusader, the co-op party game supports up to four players as they join a special Gotham
title: Batman Is Finally Getting A New Game, Just Not The One You Were Expecting

author: Ben Janca
description: Tom Caswell, a fighting game novice, works with Ben Janca, an expert in the genre, to learn the fundamentals of Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.
title: Fighting Game Novice Tries To Master Avatar Legends

author: Ben Janca
description:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield.

Phoenix Cyclops arrives in Fall 2026. Stay tuned for more details on his gameplay and abilities.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls – Phoenix Cyclops | Year 1 DLC Character Reveal Trailer

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
Advertising and the video game industry have been intertwined for decades. Growing up, I almost exclusively played licensed games that promoted movies, like Lego Star Wars or The Incredibles for my original Xbox. I enjoy the occasional round of Fortnite and can see everyone from Halo’s Master Chief to Family Guy’s Peter Griffin while doing so. Still, Xbox’s ad-supported games announcement crosses a line the company never should have. 

If you missed it, “ad-supported game streaming” is currently in testing with Xbox Insiders. Those not subscribed to Game Pass Ultimate can watch ads before they play in exchange for one hour of a game they own via cloud gaming. The Xbox Wire post about it stresses that it’s optional
title: Xbox Is Putting Ads Before Games, And It Feels Gross

author: Ben Janca
description:
Watch the official Opening Movie for MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!
Blending the intensity of classic fighting game intros with the style, heart, and energy of iconic early-2000s anime openings, this cinematic opening sets the stage for the battles ahead.

Produced by renowned Japanese animation studio Sanzigen, the opening animation is directed by Daisuke Suzuki.
The original theme song, "Stronger as One," features powerhouse vocalists Keiko Terada (SHOW-YA) and mayu (NEMOPHILA), with lyrics by Kanata Okajima and music composed and arranged by MEG (MEGMETAL).

Experience the world of MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls before stepping into the fight.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
title: MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls – Official Opening Movie Trailer

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Shawn Layden may not be at Sony anymore, but the former PlayStation boss has a lot of thoughts about the company, its games, and the industry as a whole. Specifically, he'd love to see a return to the PS1- and PS2-era of games, and he has a (somewhat vague) plan to achieve it.

In a July 23 interview with Eurogamer, Layden spoke at length about how unsustainable the current model of game development is. He discussed the untenable ballooning budgets of recent years, how niche gaming is compared to the universality of movies and music, and how the current structures just don't hold up.

Tucked into the interview was a mention of PlayStation 1 and PlayStation 2 games.

"The problem we see there is the current model incentivises or almost dictates that
title: Ex-PlayStation Boss Calls For A Return To The Good Old Days Of AA Gaming

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
While the Preview Panel at MagicCon Amsterdam focuses on the future of in-universe Magic: The Gathering, Universes Beyond did make its presence known. A separate panel, focused solely on The Hobbit, gave players a look at Magic's return to the world of Tolkien before its August release. 

We sat down with set lead Annie Sardelis, executive producer Zakeel Gordon, and principal game designer Gavin Verhey, in both one-on-one and roundtable discussions, to talk about what The Hobbit will bring to Magic: The Gather
title: The Hobbit Marks Magic: The Gathering’s First Return To Previously Visited Universes Beyond

author: Ben Janca
description: Splatoon Raiders is a change of pace for the series, and even if you're a veteran of the multiplayer games, Raiders introduces new gear and playstyles. Here's nine tips we wish we knew playing Splatoon Raiders.
title: Splatoon Raiders 9 Tips We Wish We Knew

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Hours before launching, the official Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game account on X announced that the Xbox edition of the title isn't coming out today, July 23, as planned. Instead, it's now releasing on Xbox Series X|S sometime before September 3 because of "unforeseen circumstances on a backend feature." It's quite the last-moment delay, especially considering not even 24 hours ago the same account was promoting the game's launch. That's rough, buddy. 

The bad news doesn't stop with Xbox players, either. Cross-play isn't available on Switch yet, and the only localization option on the hybrid system is English currently. Meanwhile, the Deluxe Edition is also missing in action on Switch. All of these
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game Delayed At Last Moment On Xbox

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Halo fans on Xbox excited to dive into Halo: Campaign Evolved today as part of its early access period are currently severely disappointed, as an issue is preventing them from accessing the game despite paying extra money for the privilege. 

As pointed out by players on social media (and independently verified by GameSpot), many (or possibly everyone) who purchased the Halo: Campaign Evolved premium edition or premium edition upgrade on Xbox or the Xbox PC app can't at time of writing access the game. Oops.

The premium edition, which cost $70 as opposed to the normal edition's $50, is supposed to come with five days of early access. Campaign Evolved is also available on Game Pass, and users have the option to pay an extra $20 to "upgrade" to the pr
title: Halo Players On Xbox Who Paid More To Play Early Can’t

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Amazon Games' boss Jeff Gattis has a solution for the rising cost of console gaming, but it's certainly one that nobody wants and hasn't been successful thus far: cloud gaming. Let's hear him out real quick.

In a July 23 interview with the BBC, Gattis talked about what the future of gaming could look like as consoles soar past $1,000. Although he acknowledged how important systems are to the industry as a whole, he also noticed an untapped market beyond traditional consoles that Amazon Games has been trying to reach.

"There are somewhere between 2.5 and 3 billion people who play games around the world, but only a fraction of those own dedicated gaming hardware," Gattis said. "As hardware becomes more expensive, and as streaming technology continues to improve, I think you'll naturally see more people asking whether they
title: With $1,000 Consoles On The Horizon, Amazon Games Boss Offers A Solution That Absolutely No One Asked For

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has rolled out a test for its free, ad-supported version of cloud gaming. Select members of the Xbox Insider program can start testing this out today.

As announced by Microsoft, ads play before people get into a session. The ads do not interrupt the gameplay experience like they might for ads on a TV or movie streaming platform. Sessions are limited to one hour per session, at least for now, as part of this early test version that supports games people already own.
title: Microsoft Brings Ads To Xbox In A Big New Way, Promises No Gameplay Interruption

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The proposed sale of Electronic Arts to an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) has cleared a major hurdle in the closing process. The European Commission announced today, July 23, that it has approved the merger, saying the deal does not raise competition concerns.

This was the
title: EA Sale To Saudi Arabia Clears A Major Hurdle

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Kingdom Hearts is such a significant part of many people's lives, but for former Disney CEO Michael Eisner, greenlighting the iconic Square Enix franchise was just another Tuesday. Eisner must have taken a trip through Castle Oblivion, because he seems to have forgotten why he approved the series.

Reporter Stephen Totilo of Game File briefly had the ear of Eisner after a panel about video game company Delphi Interactive, for which Eisner is an investor. Totilo asked the 84-year-old businessman if he recalled giving the go-ahead for Kingdom Hearts, which launched on PlayStation 2 in 2002. Eisner simply responded: "No."

Totilo says he clarified to Eisner that he was pitched the game in Tokyo and it was a crossover between Final Fantasy and Disney characters. While that jogged Eisner's me
title: Disney’s Former CEO Seems To Have No Memory Of Approving Kingdom Hearts

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The new Resident Evil movie from Weapons director Zach Cregger is almost here, and in a new trailer, it looks like this film will have plenty of Easter eggs for eagle-eyed fans to spot. Cregger--who is a huge fan of the Capcom survival-horror series--has previously spoken about how his film is an original story that takes place during the infamous Raccoon City Incident, one that follows a completely new character on his journey to survive a terrible night in the metropolis after it falls victim to the Umbrella Corporation's bioweapons.

The trailer starts off with star Austin Abrams--who plays the "idiot" courier Bryan--finishing up an organ delivery at a local hospital, and if you look closely at the ba
title: The New Resident Evil Movie Already Looks Like A Love Letter To The Games

description:
Shuri may have only recently taken up the mantle of Black Panther, but she's more than ready to defend Wakanda, and the world.
Learn how in her Character Guide!

Control the mid-range with the Spear of Bashenga, use Bast's Blessing to open up opponents from unexpected angles, and fight with the precision and grace worthy of Wakandan royalty.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!

description:
Epic Games has confirmed that The Simpson family, and characters from the wider world of Springfield, are returning to Fortnite.

In a social media post, the company said, "I miss my friends: Bart, Lisa, Krusty..."

A full reveal for the "Reloaded" of the Fortnite x The Simpsons event will take place on July 29, so we won't have to wait long to learn more.

title: Fortnite’s The Simpsons Crossover Is Coming Back

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Shigeru Miyamoto had some choice words for businesses that put profits over people, essentially saying it's a shame that the priority always seems to be short-term profits over long-term playability.

In a recent interview with Famitsu (that was machine translated by VGC), Miyamoto talked about his son, Mario the Plumber's, continued success in the face of companies who regularly chase profits. In pondering just why Mario remains so popular, Miyamoto explained that Nintendo as a company doesn't approach game development from a profit point of view but rather from one of playability.

He cited Pokemon and Splatoon as two franchises that were designed like this because, had they b
title: Mario Dad Miyamoto Says Companies Prioritizing Short-Term Profit Gains “Feels Like A Massive Failure”

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
San Diego Comic-Con kicks off this week, and Hasbro is once again hitting the show floor to reveal several of its upcoming figures for the year. GameSpot can exclusively reveal several of them today, including what is undeniably our favorite of the lot: a GI Joe-inspired take on the original Tomb Raider, Lara Croft.

Hasbro had previously teased this a few months back, and ahead of its launch in Fall 2026, it has dropped several new images showing off the collectible $45 action figure. Like other collectibles in the GI Joe Classified series, Lara comes sealed inside blister packaging that's a throwback to the GI Joe toys of the '80s and '90s, with artwork showing off her character design. For accessories, she comes with her signature sidearms, backpack, climbing axes, bow, a quiver for her arrows, a grappling hook, an ancient dagger, alternate hands, and a second head that is equipped with communication headphones.
title: Exclusive: Hasbro’s GI Joe Lara Croft Figure Is A Tomb Raider Worth Hunting For

description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is the best way to play through Master Chief's first game.
title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Video Review

author: Jordan Ramée
description:
There's something that almost feels sacrilegious about playing Halo on a PlayStation console. The sci-fi shooter franchise feels quintessentially Xbox, and while you've been able to play Halo: The Master Chief Collection on PC with a DualSense controller, there's something extra odd with playing a version of Halo covered in a PlayStation-oriented UI and seeing PlayStation Trophies pop with every completed in-game accomplishment. 

And yet, despite how weird it is to be playing Halo on a PlayStation 5, it's still Halo. And so it's really fun.

Not to be confused with Halo: Combat Evolved, Hal
title: It Feels Wrong For Halo To Feel Better Than Ever On PS5

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
It's a big day for Halo, as Halo: Campaign Evolved launches today, July 23, in early access. Beyond the excitement that normally surrounds the launch of a new Halo game, the release is especially notable because today will also be remembered as the day Halo finally came to PlayStation after more than two decades of console exclusivity on Xbox.

The sci-fi series debuted in 2001 as a launch title for the original Xbox, and the franchise has been exclusive, at least on console, to Xbox ever since--until today.
title: After 25 Years, Halo Is Finally On PlayStation

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Voice actor Nick Apostolides has revealed how he prepared to play Leon Kennedy in the recent Resident Evil remakes, and part of that preparation involved listening to some iconic bands.

In a Cameo video, Apostolides said he turned to some iconic metal and grunge bands. Specifically, he said Nirvana inspired his performance as Leon in Resident Evil 2 because the "grunge, rock energy" helped him get in a good headspace to play a young Leon.

He also called out Alice in Chains (and specifically the songs "Them Bones" and "Would") as his inspiration for Resident Evil 4. The actor then turned to "super heavy" Metallica to get in the groove for Leon in Resident Evil Requiem. He said Metallica's "Orion" is his favorite song of all time, and listening to it helped him prepare to play Leon in Requiem.
title: Resident Evil Actor Reveals His Inspirations For Leon Kennedy, And They Aren’t What You Expect

Lego has officially revealed its Donkey Kong Arcade set, a nostalgic throwback to one of the company's first big games. A tribute to the groundbreaking 1981 arcade hit--which starred Mario as Jumpman--the 1,371-piece set launches on August 1 and is priced at $200. It also comes with a gift in the form of an Animal Crossing kit featuring everyone's favorite landlord, Tom Nook, valued at $5, if preordered from The Lego Store.

On the Spirhalite Islands…treasure is yours for the taking. Enemies will get in your way…but you’ve got the tools to deal with them.

There are all sorts of strange environments…and the deeper you go, the more treasure you’ll find. What else lies below the surface?

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Season 5 arrives in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone on July 23, and Activision has detailed the four new weapons you can earn throughout the season. Season 5 adds a new assault rifle, light machine gun, dual SMGs, and a new melee weapon. In this guide, we'll detail all of the new Season 5 weapons in Call of Duty and how you can unlock them for free.

Content-wise, Season 5 of Call of Duty features new multiplayer maps, and one of them puts players inside a pinball machine themed around Nuketown. Zombies is getting smaller maps at the launch of the season, but the final round-based map will arrive with the midseason update. For Warzone, the Heavy Metal Heroes limited-time mode returns in battle royale. The

description:
In Phasmophobia, ghost-hunting equipment is critical for gathering evidence, capturing media, completing objectives, and ultimately, identifying the ghost. Your loadout always includes a handful of default starter equipment items, including a Flashlight, Video Camera, and Spirit Box, but as you earn XP and level your character up, item upgrades and new optional equipment become available for purchase from the lobby shop that can make ghosts easier to identify.

title: How To Use All Phasmophobia Items For Ghost-Hunting

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
A new trailer for Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie has arrived, providing a new look at the scary video game adaptation.

In this new trailer, we see the medical courier Bryan (Austin Abrams) at a hospital where he takes on a new job where he must ferry organs to "Raccoon City General," a hospital "outside the zone."

The job pays double, so Bryan takes it. Then, well, everything goes badly as Bryan finds himself in a world of hell. Take a look:

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A new firmware update for PS5 consoles has been released, and as usual, it's not much to write home about. PS5 update version: 26.04-13.60.00 once again keeps things simple, offering a very incremental enhancement to the Sony-produced hardware.

"We've improved the messages and usability on some screens," the extremely brief update notes read.

The last major PS5 update was focused on the PS5 Pro, as it introduced an upgraded version of PSSR (PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution) for owners of the beefier machine. Beyond that, we've seen an improved Friends Activity widget, the option to check your PS5 console serial number, and a power saver mode added in older firmware updates alongside the usual rounds of stability improvements. Just in tim
title: New PS5 Update Is Out Now, Makes Reading Easier

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Like several other first-party Sony games, Marvel's Wolverine relied on motion-capture work to draw an authentic performance from its cast. Spartacus actor Liam McIntyre plays the iconic mutant in Insomniac's new game, and in a recent interview, he explained how the role required him to dig deep to find the feral side of Wolverine that erupts from him whenever he enters a berserker state.

While McIntyre originally wanted to reference rabid dogs for inspiration--content "which is, first of all, very hard to find, probably for the best," he said to EW--his take on the character seeing red did terrify the team at Insomniac Games.

title: Marvel’s Wolverine Actor Reveals The Performance That Terrified Him
